newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares rise on back of SKB strength.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares rise on back of SKB strength.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 0.70 percent on Thursday, propped up by a rise in bank SKB ahead of its shareholders meeting today.
The meeting is expected to discuss the bank's listing abroad.
"The jump in SKB was certainly one of the main reasons for today's rise. But the future is still hard to predict, as the composition of the next government remains unknown," one trader said.
* The 10-share SBI index rose 8.15 points to 1,173.7.
* Bank SKB rose 5.05 percent or 2,120 tolars to 44,130 tolars on volume of 2,378 shares.
* Overall seven shares rose and seven fell, while 10 were untraded. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
